verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a Gusto data-sync integration and a secured data room. Neither shows a mechanism for authorizing law firms, HRIS vendors or wealth managers to access scoped slices of equity data without admin credentials, such as role-based permissions, scoped API tokens or delegated access. The Gusto sync is an adjacent integration, not scoped third-party access, and probes found no public API spec.

support.subject: As a developer, third parties my company authorizes — law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers — can access scoped slices of equity data on our behalf without full admin credentials
